views.name: leaf_topics
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    slug,
    name,
    root_branch,
    level
   FROM topics t
  WHERE (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM topics c
          WHERE (c.parent_id = t.id))));

views.name: parent_topics
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    slug,
    name,
    root_branch,
    level
   FROM topics
  WHERE (parent_id IS NULL);

views.name: topic_hierarchy
views.definition:
SELECT p.root_branch,
    p.name AS parent_name,
    c.name AS child_name,
    c.slug AS child_slug
   FROM (topics p
     LEFT JOIN topics c ON ((c.parent_id = p.id)))
  WHERE (p.parent_id IS NULL)
  ORDER BY p.root_branch, p.name, c.name;

views.name: v_claim_evidence
views.definition:
SELECT c.id AS claim_id,
    c.claim_text,
    c.stance,
    c.confidence,
    s.id AS source_id,
    s.name AS source_name,
    s.source_type,
    s.year AS source_year,
    m.id AS molecule_id,
    m.name AS molecule_name
   FROM ((((claims c
     LEFT JOIN claim_sources cs ON ((cs.claim_id = c.id)))
     LEFT JOIN sources s ON ((s.id = cs.source_id)))
     LEFT JOIN claim_molecules cm ON ((cm.claim_id = c.id)))
     LEFT JOIN molecules m ON ((m.id = cm.molecule_id)));

views.name: v_experiment_record
views.definition:
SELECT e.id AS experiment_id,
    e.name AS experiment_name,
    s.id AS source_id,
    s.name AS source_name,
    ( SELECT array_agg(am.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (experiment_methods em
             JOIN analytical_methods am ON ((am.id = em.method_id)))
          WHERE (em.experiment_id = e.id)) AS methods,
    ( SELECT array_agg(sa.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (experiment_sensory_attributes esa
             JOIN sensory_attributes sa ON ((sa.id = esa.attribute_id)))
          WHERE (esa.experiment_id = e.id)) AS sensory_attributes,
    ( SELECT array_agg(m.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (experiment_molecules em
             JOIN molecules m ON ((m.id = em.molecule_id)))
          WHERE (em.experiment_id = e.id)) AS molecules,
    ( SELECT array_agg(format('%s @ %s°C, %s min'::text, p.cooking_method, p.temperature_c, p.time_min)) AS array_agg
           FROM processes p
          WHERE (p.experiment_id = e.id)) AS process_summary
   FROM (experiments e
     JOIN sources s ON ((s.id = e.source_id)));

views.name: v_experts_3tier
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    external_id,
    name,
    affiliation,
    country,
    research_field,
    h_index,
    total_papers,
    relevance_score,
    outreach_status,
        CASE
            WHEN (relevance_score >= 0.80) THEN '1_high'::text
            WHEN (relevance_score >= 0.60) THEN '2_mid'::text
            ELSE '3_low'::text
        END AS relevance_tier
   FROM experts
  ORDER BY relevance_score DESC;

views.name: v_intelligence_record
views.definition:
SELECT id AS source_id,
    name AS title,
    source_type,
    year,
    ( SELECT array_agg(pc.name ORDER BY pc.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (source_product_contexts spc
             JOIN product_contexts pc ON ((pc.id = spc.context_id)))
          WHERE ((spc.source_id = s.id) AND (spc.role = 'primary'::text))) AS product_context,
    ( SELECT array_agg(pc.name ORDER BY pc.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (source_product_contexts spc
             JOIN product_contexts pc ON ((pc.id = spc.context_id)))
          WHERE ((spc.source_id = s.id) AND (spc.role = 'alternative'::text))) AS alternative_product,
    ( SELECT array_agg(t.name ORDER BY t.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (source_topics st
             JOIN topics t ON ((t.id = st.topic_id)))
          WHERE ((st.source_id = s.id) AND (t.root_branch = 'flavor_chemistry'::text))) AS chemistry_topics,
    ( SELECT array_agg(r.name ORDER BY r.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (source_reactions sr
             JOIN reactions r ON ((r.id = sr.reaction_id)))
          WHERE (sr.source_id = s.id)) AS reactions,
    ( SELECT array_agg(am.name ORDER BY am.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (source_methods sm
             JOIN analytical_methods am ON ((am.id = sm.method_id)))
          WHERE (sm.source_id = s.id)) AS analytical_methods,
    ( SELECT array_agg(sa.name ORDER BY sa.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (source_sensory_attributes ssa
             JOIN sensory_attributes sa ON ((sa.id = ssa.attribute_id)))
          WHERE (ssa.source_id = s.id)) AS sensory_attributes,
    ( SELECT array_agg(m.name ORDER BY m.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (source_molecules sm
             JOIN molecules m ON ((m.id = sm.molecule_id)))
          WHERE (sm.source_id = s.id)) AS molecules,
    ( SELECT array_agg(i.name ORDER BY i.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (source_ingredients si
             JOIN ingredients i ON ((i.id = si.ingredient_id)))
          WHERE (si.source_id = s.id)) AS ingredients,
    ( SELECT array_agg(format('%s @ %s°C, %s min'::text, p.cooking_method, p.temperature_c, p.time_min)) AS array_agg
           FROM processes p
          WHERE (p.source_id = s.id)) AS process_summary,
    ( SELECT array_agg(format('protein=%s, fat=%s'::text, mp.protein_source, mp.fat_source)) AS array_agg
           FROM matrix_profiles mp
          WHERE (mp.source_id = s.id)) AS matrix_summary
   FROM sources s;

views.name: v_meaty_molecules_ranked
views.definition:
SELECT m.id AS molecule_id,
    m.name AS molecule_name,
    m.category,
    mvl.beef_relevance_score,
    mvl.likely_process,
    mvl.chemical_group,
    mvl.subgroup,
    mvl.odor_descriptor AS reference_odor,
    mvl.cooked_meats_reported,
    ( SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT o.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (molecule_odours mo
             JOIN odours o ON ((o.id = mo.odour_id)))
          WHERE (mo.molecule_id = m.id)) AS my_odours
   FROM (molecules m
     JOIN meaty_volatile_library mvl ON ((lower(m.name) = lower(mvl.compound))))
  ORDER BY mvl.beef_relevance_score DESC NULLS LAST;

views.definition:
SELECT mvl.entry_no,
    mvl.compound AS mvl_compound,
    mvl.beef_relevance_score,
    m.id AS molecule_id,
    m.name AS molecule_name,
        CASE
            WHEN (lower(m.name) = lower(mvl.compound)) THEN 'exact_name'::text
            WHEN (m.cas_number = mvl.cas_number) THEN 'cas_match'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS match_type
   FROM (meaty_volatile_library mvl
     JOIN molecules m ON (((lower(m.name) = lower(mvl.compound)) OR (m.cas_number = mvl.cas_number))));

views.definition:
SELECT r.id AS reaction_id,
    r.name AS reaction_name,
    r.kind AS reaction_kind,
    rp.role AS participant_role,
    COALESCE(m.name, i.name) AS participant_name,
        CASE
            WHEN (m.id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'molecule'::text
            ELSE 'ingredient'::text
        END AS participant_type
   FROM (((reactions r
     JOIN reaction_participants rp ON ((rp.reaction_id = r.id)))
     LEFT JOIN molecules m ON ((m.id = rp.molecule_id)))
     LEFT JOIN ingredients i ON ((i.id = rp.ingredient_id)));

views.name: v_relevance_summary
views.definition:
SELECT 'sources'::text AS entity,
    v_sources_3tier.relevance_tier,
    count(*) AS n
   FROM v_sources_3tier
  GROUP BY v_sources_3tier.relevance_tier
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'experts'::text AS entity,
    v_experts_3tier.relevance_tier,
    count(*) AS n
   FROM v_experts_3tier
  GROUP BY v_experts_3tier.relevance_tier
  ORDER BY 1, 2;

views.name: v_sources_3tier
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    external_id,
    name,
    year,
    venue,
    url,
    citation_count,
    composite_score,
    review_status,
    trust_tier,
        CASE
            WHEN (composite_score >= (0.70)::double precision) THEN '1_high'::text
            WHEN (composite_score >= (0.50)::double precision) THEN '2_mid'::text

views.name: leaf_topics
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    slug,
    name,
    root_branch,
    level
   FROM topics t
  WHERE (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM topics c
          WHERE (c.parent_id = t.id))));

views.name: parent_topics
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    slug,
    name,
    root_branch,
    level
   FROM topics
  WHERE (parent_id IS NULL);

views.name: topic_hierarchy
views.definition:
SELECT p.root_branch,
    p.name AS parent_name,
    c.name AS child_name,
    c.slug AS child_slug
   FROM (topics p
     LEFT JOIN topics c ON ((c.parent_id = p.id)))
  WHERE (p.parent_id IS NULL)
  ORDER BY p.root_branch, p.name, c.name;

views.name: v_claim_evidence
views.definition:
SELECT c.id AS claim_id,
    c.claim_text,
    c.stance,
    c.confidence,
    s.id AS source_id,
    s.name AS source_name,
    s.source_type,
    s.year AS source_year,
    m.id AS molecule_id,
    m.name AS molecule_name
   FROM ((((claims c
     LEFT JOIN claim_sources cs ON ((cs.claim_id = c.id)))
     LEFT JOIN sources s ON ((s.id = cs.source_id)))
     LEFT JOIN claim_molecules cm ON ((cm.claim_id = c.id)))
     LEFT JOIN molecules m ON ((m.id = cm.molecule_id)));

views.name: v_experiment_record
views.definition:
SELECT e.id AS experiment_id,
    e.name AS experiment_name,
    s.id AS source_id,
    s.name AS source_name,
    ( SELECT array_agg(am.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (experiment_methods em
             JOIN analytical_methods am ON ((am.id = em.method_id)))
          WHERE (em.experiment_id = e.id)) AS methods,
    ( SELECT array_agg(sa.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (experiment_sensory_attributes esa
             JOIN sensory_attributes sa ON ((sa.id = esa.attribute_id)))
          WHERE (esa.experiment_id = e.id)) AS sensory_attributes,
    ( SELECT array_agg(m.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (experiment_molecules em
             JOIN molecules m ON ((m.id = em.molecule_id)))
          WHERE (em.experiment_id = e.id)) AS molecules,
    ( SELECT array_agg(format('%s @ %s°C, %s min'::text, p.cooking_method, p.temperature_c, p.time_min)) AS array_agg
           FROM processes p
          WHERE (p.experiment_id = e.id)) AS process_summary
   FROM (experiments e
     JOIN sources s ON ((s.id = e.source_id)));

views.name: v_experts_3tier
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    external_id,
    name,
    affiliation,
    country,
    research_field,
    h_index,
    total_papers,
    relevance_score,
    outreach_status,
        CASE
            WHEN (relevance_score >= 0.80) THEN '1_high'::text
            WHEN (relevance_score >= 0.60) THEN '2_mid'::text
            ELSE '3_low'::text
        END AS relevance_tier
   FROM experts
  ORDER BY relevance_score DESC;

views.name: v_intelligence_record
views.definition:
SELECT id AS source_id,
    name AS title,
    source_type,
    year,
    ( SELECT array_agg(pc.name ORDER BY pc.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (source_product_contexts spc
             JOIN product_contexts pc ON ((pc.id = spc.context_id)))
          WHERE ((spc.source_id = s.id) AND (spc.role = 'primary'::text))) AS product_context,
    ( SELECT array_agg(pc.name ORDER BY pc.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (source_product_contexts spc
             JOIN product_contexts pc ON ((pc.id = spc.context_id)))
          WHERE ((spc.source_id = s.id) AND (spc.role = 'alternative'::text))) AS alternative_product,
    ( SELECT array_agg(t.name ORDER BY t.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (source_topics st
             JOIN topics t ON ((t.id = st.topic_id)))
          WHERE ((st.source_id = s.id) AND (t.root_branch = 'flavor_chemistry'::text))) AS chemistry_topics,
    ( SELECT array_agg(r.name ORDER BY r.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (source_reactions sr
             JOIN reactions r ON ((r.id = sr.reaction_id)))
          WHERE (sr.source_id = s.id)) AS reactions,
    ( SELECT array_agg(am.name ORDER BY am.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (source_methods sm
             JOIN analytical_methods am ON ((am.id = sm.method_id)))
          WHERE (sm.source_id = s.id)) AS analytical_methods,
    ( SELECT array_agg(sa.name ORDER BY sa.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (source_sensory_attributes ssa
             JOIN sensory_attributes sa ON ((sa.id = ssa.attribute_id)))
          WHERE (ssa.source_id = s.id)) AS sensory_attributes,
    ( SELECT array_agg(m.name ORDER BY m.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (source_molecules sm
             JOIN molecules m ON ((m.id = sm.molecule_id)))
          WHERE (sm.source_id = s.id)) AS molecules,
    ( SELECT array_agg(i.name ORDER BY i.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (source_ingredients si
             JOIN ingredients i ON ((i.id = si.ingredient_id)))
          WHERE (si.source_id = s.id)) AS ingredients,
    ( SELECT array_agg(format('%s @ %s°C, %s min'::text, p.cooking_method, p.temperature_c, p.time_min)) AS array_agg
           FROM processes p
          WHERE (p.source_id = s.id)) AS process_summary,
    ( SELECT array_agg(format('protein=%s, fat=%s'::text, mp.protein_source, mp.fat_source)) AS array_agg
           FROM matrix_profiles mp
          WHERE (mp.source_id = s.id)) AS matrix_summary
   FROM sources s;

views.name: v_meaty_molecules_ranked
views.definition:
SELECT m.id AS molecule_id,
    m.name AS molecule_name,
    m.category,
    mvl.beef_relevance_score,
    mvl.likely_process,
    mvl.chemical_group,
    mvl.subgroup,
    mvl.odor_descriptor AS reference_odor,
    mvl.cooked_meats_reported,
    ( SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT o.name) AS array_agg
           FROM (molecule_odours mo
             JOIN odours o ON ((o.id = mo.odour_id)))
          WHERE (mo.molecule_id = m.id)) AS my_odours
   FROM (molecules m
     JOIN meaty_volatile_library mvl ON ((lower(m.name) = lower(mvl.compound))))
  ORDER BY mvl.beef_relevance_score DESC NULLS LAST;

views.name: v_mvl_gaps
views.definition:
SELECT entry_no,
    compound,
    cas_number,
    likely_process,
    chemical_group,
    beef_relevance_score,
    odor_descriptor
   FROM meaty_volatile_library mvl
  WHERE (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM molecules m
          WHERE ((lower(m.name) = lower(mvl.compound)) OR ((m.cas_number IS NOT NULL) AND (m.cas_number = mvl.cas_number))))))
  ORDER BY beef_relevance_score DESC NULLS LAST;

views.name: v_mvl_x_molecules_by_cas
views.definition:
SELECT mvl.entry_no,
    mvl.compound,
    mvl.cas_number,
    mvl.beef_relevance_score,
    m.id AS molecule_id,
    m.name AS molecule_name
   FROM (meaty_volatile_library mvl
     JOIN molecules m ON ((m.cas_number = mvl.cas_number)))
  WHERE ((mvl.cas_number IS NOT NULL) AND (m.cas_number IS NOT NULL));

views.name: v_mvl_x_molecules_by_name
views.definition:
SELECT mvl.entry_no,
    mvl.compound AS mvl_compound,
    mvl.cas_number AS mvl_cas,
    mvl.likely_process,
    mvl.chemical_group,
    mvl.beef_relevance_score,
    mvl.odor_descriptor AS mvl_odor,
    m.id AS molecule_id,
    m.name AS molecule_name,
    m.category AS molecule_category,
    m.compound_id AS odour_org_uk_id
   FROM (meaty_volatile_library mvl
     JOIN molecules m ON ((lower(m.name) = lower(mvl.compound))));

views.name: v_mvl_x_molecules_fuzzy
views.definition:
SELECT mvl.entry_no,
    mvl.compound AS mvl_compound,
    mvl.beef_relevance_score,
    m.id AS molecule_id,
    m.name AS molecule_name,
        CASE
            WHEN (lower(m.name) = lower(mvl.compound)) THEN 'exact_name'::text
            WHEN (m.cas_number = mvl.cas_number) THEN 'cas_match'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS match_type
   FROM (meaty_volatile_library mvl
     JOIN molecules m ON (((lower(m.name) = lower(mvl.compound)) OR (m.cas_number = mvl.cas_number))));

views.name: v_precursors
views.definition:
SELECT reaction_id,
    reaction_name,
    reaction_kind,
    participant_role,
    participant_name,
    participant_type
   FROM v_reaction_participants_named
  WHERE (participant_role = 'precursor'::participant_role);

views.name: v_reaction_participants_named
views.definition:
SELECT r.id AS reaction_id,
    r.name AS reaction_name,
    r.kind AS reaction_kind,
    rp.role AS participant_role,
    COALESCE(m.name, i.name) AS participant_name,
        CASE
            WHEN (m.id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'molecule'::text
            ELSE 'ingredient'::text
        END AS participant_type
   FROM (((reactions r
     JOIN reaction_participants rp ON ((rp.reaction_id = r.id)))
     LEFT JOIN molecules m ON ((m.id = rp.molecule_id)))
     LEFT JOIN ingredients i ON ((i.id = rp.ingredient_id)));

views.name: v_relevance_summary
views.definition:
SELECT 'sources'::text AS entity,
    v_sources_3tier.relevance_tier,
    count(*) AS n
   FROM v_sources_3tier
  GROUP BY v_sources_3tier.relevance_tier
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'experts'::text AS entity,
    v_experts_3tier.relevance_tier,
    count(*) AS n
   FROM v_experts_3tier
  GROUP BY v_experts_3tier.relevance_tier
  ORDER BY 1, 2;

views.name: v_sources_3tier
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    external_id,
    name,
    year,
    venue,
    url,
    citation_count,
    composite_score,
    review_status,
    trust_tier,
        CASE
            WHEN (composite_score >= (0.70)::double precision) THEN '1_high'::text
            WHEN (composite_score >= (0.50)::double precision) THEN '2_mid'::text
            ELSE '3_low'::text
        END AS relevance_tier
   FROM sources
  ORDER BY composite_score DESC;
